title: The War Australia Lost To Birds

scenes.say: In 1932, Australia went to war against birds. And lost.
About twenty thousand emus were eating the wheat on farms in Western Australia.
scenes.label: eating the farmers' wheat

scenes.say: So the army sent soldiers, two machine guns, and ten thousand rounds of ammunition.
scenes.heading: THE ARMY ARRIVES

scenes.say: But every time they opened fire, the emus split up and ran.
The commanding major later said: they can face machine guns with the invulnerability of tanks.
In the end, they fired nearly ten thousand rounds and killed fewer than a thousand emus. About ten bullets per bird.
scenes.label: per emu

scenes.say: And the emu population? Barely affected.
scenes.heading: THE RESULT
